en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.), “One who recites Surah Infitar and  Surah  Inshiqaq  in  his  obligatory  and  recommended prayer, Allah will eliminate all the barriers to the fulfillment of  his desires. There would be nothing to stop him. Allah will look at him with mercy till accounting of deeds of all the people is done.”
